script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for June 6. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Every culture on Earth dances.  From tribal ceremonies to nightclubs, humans move together to rhythm.  We danced before we wrote, before we farmed, maybe before we had language.

When people move together in rhythm, their heart rates synchronize. Their brain waves align. Trust increases. Pain tolerance rises. Dance literally puts a group on the same wavelength—it's social bonding through movement. Dance may predate language.  Early humans couldn't explain complex emotions, but they could move together.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Some truths are embodied, not spoken.  Dance teaches that the body knows things the mind cannot articulate.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Movement Expression - Let Your Body Speak.

Here's your activity: Put on music and move—in private if you're shy. Don't perform; just let your body respond to rhythm. Notice how movement affects your mood. Your body has wisdom that sitting still can't access. This helps you use movement to access and express emotion.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about why every culture dances can be applied to movement expression - let your body speak. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
